title: Marketplace package page: the suggested-binding prompt and toasts name the permission set by its machine name (same class as #33864 item 1)
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmT2NE3iyG1o6TDg3sf

Filing gate: ③ an out-of-scope finding of the #33864 dev (os-dev report 6899087689 on PR #34088), class a.
Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`, the `SuggestedBindingsPanel` mount). Grade suggestion: p3 (the same `ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names` defect #33864 is p3 for).
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open suggested binding marketplace label` — only #33864, whose Studio Access half is fixed by PR #34088.

## 维护者速读

应用市场的包详情页安装后，同样会出现「建议把权限集授权给所有人」的横幅和提示，但这里仍然用权限集的机器名（如 `qa_note_readers`）而不是标签（如「QA Note Readers」）。#33864 在 Studio → 访问 里修好了同一个横幅，这一处是同一个组件的另一个挂载点，没改到。

## Facts (read on the PR #34088 head)

- `SuggestedBindingsPanel` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/components/SuggestedBindingsPanel.tsx`) draws every string through callbacks its mount passes.
- PR #34088 makes the Studio Access mount name the set by the label the pillar's rail reads (`suggestedSetLabel` in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`).
- The Marketplace package page mount passes `s.permission_set_name` into its prompt and toasts, so it still names the set by machine name.

## Ask

Name the set by its label (machine name at most secondary text) on the Marketplace package page mount. If that page holds no permission-set labels, say where the label is read from; if the suggestion payload itself should carry the label, stop and report rather than editing `packages/**`. Consider one shared label helper with the Studio mount instead of a second copy. Pins: the label is shown in the prompt and in the Grant/Dismiss/Revoke toasts; ablate red.

Blocked-by: #33864
